'''Saki Endo''' (Japanese: '''遠藤沙季''' ''Endō Saki'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Endo was born on March 7, 1986 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced [[Team Skull]] Admin [[Plumeria]]. Endo is currently affiliated with New Walkers.
